name: DATABRICKS_DSN
description: ODBC DSN

name: DATABRICKS_CATALOG
description: Catalog for all reads and writes

name: MDV_SCHEMA
description: MDV schema (the one the OC business rules read)

name: USE_QUARTERLY_TABLES
description: Read each MDV table as t_<name>_<vintage>

name: MDV_VINTAGE
description: The MDV extract's quarterly suffix; blank derives it from STUDY_END

name: STUDY_START
description: Study period start; the cohort must not index before it

name: STUDY_END
description: Study period end; the cohort must not run past it

name: CODELIST_DIR
description: Where the MDV code lists live (MDV vocabulary; not the Optum lists)

name: PERSIST_TO_SCHEMA
description: Write the outputs to the schema

name: CENSOR_AT_DISENROLLMENT
description: On MDV: censor at the patient's last record (ENDDATE_CE). A patient who stops attending cannot be told from one who stopped treatment

name: INDUCTION_WINDOW_DAYS
description: LOT1 induction window

name: INDUCTION_WINDOW_DAYS_LOT_N
description: Induction window for LOT2 and later

name: MAP_DISCON_GAP_DAYS
description: MAP-level discontinuation gap

name: LOT_DISCON_CONFIRM_DAYS
description: Observation required after a run-out before it is a discontinuation

name: MEDICAL_DAY_SUPPLY
description: Days one injected administration covers (CL_ROUTE=INJ); the dominant assumption on MDV

name: ORAL_DAYS_DEFAULT
description: Days an oral act covers where the act carries no days supplied (outpatient); an inpatient oral act with none covers 1

name: SCT_AUTO_WINDOW_DAYS
description: AUTO transplant detection window

name: SCT_AUTO_GAP_DAYS
description: AUTO transplant gap

name: SCT_TANDEM_DAYS
description: Tandem transplant window

name: CART_CONSOLIDATION_DAYS
description: New agents within this of CAR-T are consolidation

name: ALLO_LOT_SPAN
description: An ALLO line spans only the transplant date

name: MAX_LOT
description: Highest line number built

name: FACE_VALIDITY_FATAL
description: Stop the build when a face-validity check falls outside its band (default: report only)

name: COHORT_STATUS_TABLE
description: What the cohort build calls its run-status table before the prefix (blank = try the usual names)

name: COHORT_PREFIX
description: The cohort build's prefix for that table (blank = this run's own prefix)

name: APPLY_NO_BELANTAMAB
description: Drop patients with belantamab in any LOT

name: APPLY_CART_INDUCTION_RULE
description: A CAR-T inside LOT1's induction window belongs to LOT1

name: BELANTAMAB_MED_ABBR
description: How belantamab is named in MED_ABBR

name: APPLY_MELP_RULE
description: The study's melphalan rule; only off is accepted otherwise and it needs LOT_CONTRACT_OVERRIDE

name: APPLY_OWN_RETURN_FOLD
description: a drug of the line's own regimen returning after a gap does not open the next line (LOT_RULES.md 4.3)

name: APPLY_MAP_FOLDIN
description: A prior line's agent returning joins the line it returns in when one agent advanced the line in between

name: MELP_MED_ABBR
description: How melphalan is named in MED_ABBR

name: MELP_EXPOSURE_DAYS
description: Doses closer together than this are one administration

name: MELP_SIMPLE_COURSE_DAYS
description: Simplified mode: a course covering this many days or fewer outside induction does not advance on its own

name: MDV_TBL_DISEASE
description: MDV diagnosis table (base name)

name: MDV_TBL_PATIENT
description: MDV patient table (base name)

name: MDV_TBL_FF1
description: MDV DPC Form 1 episode table (base name)

name: MDV_TBL_DRUG
description: MDV drug master (base name)

name: MDV_TBL_ACT
description: MDV act table (base name)

name: MDV_COL_PATIENTID
description: Patient key in every table

name: MDV_COL_DATAMONTH
description: Claim month on the diagnosis table

name: MDV_COL_NYUGAIKBN
description: Care setting on the diagnosis table

name: MDV_COL_DISEASECODE
description: MDV disease code

name: MDV_COL_ICD10
description: ICD-10 code on the diagnosis table (blank = the delivery has none)

name: MDV_COL_UTAGAIFLG
description: Suspected-diagnosis flag

name: MDV_COL_CANCERFLG
description: Cancer-diagnosis flag

name: MDV_COL_FROMDATE
description: Day-level diagnosis date

name: MDV_COL_SEX
description: Sex on the patient table

name: MDV_COL_BIRTH
description: Birth year / year-month / date (CONFIRM the name)

name: MDV_COL_FF1STARTDATE
description: FF1 admission date

name: MDV_COL_FF1ENDDATE
description: FF1 discharge date

name: MDV_COL_CANCERFIRSTFLG
description: FF1 first-occurrence cancer flag

name: MDV_COL_CHEMOTHERAPYFLG
description: FF1 chemotherapy flag

name: MDV_COL_FF1_OUTCOME
description: FF1 discharge outcome (blank = death not observed; CONFIRM the name)

name: MDV_COL_RECEIPTCODE
description: Receipt code on the drug master and the act table

name: MDV_COL_RECEIPTNAME_ENG
description: English drug name on the drug master

name: MDV_COL_ACTDATE
description: Date of an act

name: MDV_COL_ACT_NYUGAIKBN
description: Care setting on the act table (blank = not carried)

name: MDV_COL_ACT_DAYS
description: Days supplied on the act table (blank = not carried; ORAL_DAYS_DEFAULT applies)

name: MDV_INPATIENT
description: nyugaikbn value for inpatient

name: MDV_OUTPATIENT
description: nyugaikbn value for outpatient

name: MDV_CONFIRMED
description: utagaiflg value for a confirmed diagnosis

name: MDV_CANCER
description: cancerflg value for a cancer diagnosis

name: MDV_FIRSTCANCER
description: cancerfirstflg value for a first occurrence

name: MDV_NO_CHEMO
description: chemotherapyflg value for no chemotherapy

name: MDV_SEX_MALE
description: sex value for male

name: MDV_SEX_FEMALE
description: sex value for female

name: MDV_DEATH_OUTCOMES
description: Discharge outcome values that are a death
